invariants.rationale: A new ArrayList is always created and returned, so result is never null.
Result is declared as List<SmallFile> and is always either a new ArrayList or the same local variable.
Partition path is always passed to sub-methods that require non-null argument; otherwise, the code would throw.
Whenever elements are added to smallFileLocations, they are non-null SmallFile objects.
Only files with file size less than the configured small file limit are added to the result list.
